_about: AICP-390: project ecb9ac03 (Whatshedoing_Creator, 2026-11-05): its transcribe/v3 transcript, the segments after the AICP-347 re-cut and the scene cuts of its source. It ends with the source's own CTA end card (off-screen narrator over a promo graphic, 49.07-54.47 s).

transcript.video_summary: A woman in a bookstore demonstrates the Listenify app to an interviewer, showing how it reads scanned text aloud. She highlights its features, including changing the voice to celebrity options like Snoop Dogg and adjusting the playback speed, emphasizing that it frees her from reading glasses and looking at screens. The video ends with a promotional graphic for the app.
transcript.scene_context: The scene takes place in a bookstore where a woman is interacting with an off-screen interviewer who is holding a small white microphone towards her. The woman uses her smartphone to demonstrate the app, holding it up for the camera to see the screen clearly during key moments like scanning text, changing voices, and adjusting the reading speed.
